book.name: Kolose
book.title: Kolose Lenji Leta Pol Le Rorori

content: Yawalɨ togha thanavuniye weya Krais
Weimi Krais kaero Loi i vaŋguthuweiruŋa mare e tɨne na kaero e yawayawalimiva, iya kaiwae nuwamina mbe i ghaŋgowe vara bigibigi nanji e buruburu. Krais kaero ina gheko na i yaku Loi e uneke.
Mbe hu rerenuwaŋa vara bigibigi yavoroke kaiwanji; na thava lemi renuwaŋana i ghaŋgowa yambaneke bigibiginiye.
Ghemi kaerova hu mare yawalɨ teuye e tɨne, na mbaŋake iyake weimi Krais e yawalimi togha Loi e marae.
Krais iye yawalimi rɨghe moli, na mbaŋa Krais ne i yomarava, ne weimi hu yomara na hu vwenyevwenye.

Yambaneke thanavuniyeke wolaghɨye iya ina e yawalimina mbema hu roiteteŋgi vara moli, ŋgoreiya yathima thanavuniye raraitharɨ, monjina thanavuniye, numwe thanavuniye, tharɨ ghavakatha gharerenuwaŋa, na ŋgaŋganirɨ thanavuniye (kaiwae ŋgaŋganirɨ thanavuniye ŋgoreiya ra kururu weŋgiya loi kwanɨkwan.)
Thanavu ŋgoranjiyako kaiwanji Loi le ghatemuru i menamena weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ ma thɨ ghambugha ghalɨŋae.
Ghemi va hu vakavakatha iya thanavuŋgiko thiyako na yawalimina va ŋgora iyako.
Ko iyemaeŋge e mbaŋake iyake hu bigiyathuŋgiya thanavuke thiyake: wogaithɨ, ghatemuru, yanji, utuvatharɨ weŋgiya ghandaune na utu raraitharɨ.
Thava hu utu kwanɨkwan weŋgiya ghamune, kaiwae yawalimi teuye weiye thanavuniye kaero hu wokiyathu,

na kaero hu njimbo yawalimi togha. Loi kaero i vatoghaŋaŋga, na iye mbe i vavatoghaŋaŋga vara, na yawalimina ghathuwathuwa ŋgoreiya amalaghɨniye ghami Ravakatha ŋgaliŋgaliya, na ghaghareghare i laghɨye e ghemi.

Iyake kaiwae ma e ghatomethi, thoŋgo ghinda Jiu o Grik gharɨgharɨniye ŋgoreiye, thoŋgo ghinda ra wo kitenɨyathu thanavuniye o ma ra wo kitenɨyathu thanavuniye, thoŋgo mbe ghalɨghalɨŋa regha gharɨgharɨniye, thoŋgo ghinda wabwi ma thanavu ina weŋgi, thoŋgo ghinda rakakaiwobwaga o rakarakayathu gharɨgharɨniye. Ko iyemaeŋge Krais iye bigibigike wolaghɨye, na iye i yaku weŋgiya raloŋweloŋweghathɨke wolaghɨye.
Iya kaiwae ghemi Loi le tututhi gharɨgharɨniye, hu boboma na i gharethovuŋga. Mbala hu njimboŋgiya thanavuke thiyake: gharevɨrɨ, mwaewo, gharenja, thanavu udauda na ghataŋaghathɨ.
Mbe e lemi ghataŋaghathɨ weŋga regha na regha na hu venumotenɨŋga mbaŋa thoŋgo lolo regha e tɨnemina i liya gheu regha ghautu. Hu venumotenɨŋga ŋgoreiya Giya kaerova i numotenɨŋga.
Na thanavuke thiyake e vwatanji hu woraweya gharethovu thanavuniye, kaiwae iye i tubweŋgiya na regha thanavuke thovuthovuye wolaghɨye.
Hu vakatha Krais le gharemalɨlɨ i mbaroŋa gharemi na yawalimi, kaiwae e gharemalɨlɨko iyako tɨne iya Loi va i kulana e ghemi na hu wabwi na regha. Na mbaŋake wolaghɨye hu vata ago weya Loi.

Mbaŋake wolaghɨye mbe hu rerenuwaŋa Krais utuutuniye. Weiye lemi thimbana wolaghɨye hu vavaghare na hu vavurɨghegheŋga regha na regha. Na mbaŋa hu wothuŋaŋgiya sam, kururu ghawothu na wothu vavanava ŋgoreiya Nyao Boboma le woraŋgiya e ghemi e gharemina hu vata ago weya Loi.
Bigibigina wolaghɨye iya hu vakavakathana na hu utuutuŋana, hu vakatha Giya Jisas e idae. Na amalaghɨniye e idae hu vata ago weya Loi Ramanda.
Raloŋweloŋweghathɨ lenji ŋgolo gharayakuyaku lenji yakuyaku utuniye
Ghemi ragheghe wanakau, hu ghambugha lemi ghɨmoghɨmoru lenji renuwaŋa, kaiwae thanavu ŋgoranjiyako i thovuye weŋgiya raloŋweloŋweghathɨ.
Ghemi ragheghe ghɨmoghɨmoru, hu gharethovu weŋgiya lemi ovo na thava ghamithanavu i vurɨgheghe weŋgi.
Gamagai, hu ghambugha otatami na orarami lenji renuwaŋa e bigibigike wolaghɨye, kaiwae iyake Giya i warariŋa.
Ghemi oramaramanji, thava hu wonjoŋanjoŋaŋgiya lemi ŋgaŋgana, ne iwaeŋge hu vakowana ghamɨnanji, ko amba thɨ renuwaŋa na thɨŋava ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ vakatha bigi thovuye regha.

Ghemi rakakaiwobwaga, ghamigiyagiya e yambaneke hu ghambugha lenji renuwaŋa e bigibigike wolaghɨye. Thava kaiwae mbe maranji vara weŋga amba hu kaiwo na thovuye, na mbala thɨ warari kaiwami. Ko iyemaeŋge hu kaiwo weiye lemi gharevatomwe na lemi yavwatata weya Giya.
The kaiwo hu vakatha, hu vakatha weiye gharemina laghɨye, ŋgoreiya hu kaiwo weya Giya na ma gharɨgharɨ kaiwanji ŋgoreiye.
Kaiwae hu ghareghare budakaiya Giya va i vivatharawe le gharɨgharɨ kaiwanji ne i wogiya e ghemi. Ghemi Krais le rakakaiwo, na ghemi ghami Giya moli.
Tharɨ gharavakatha regha na regha ne i wo modae le tharɨko kaiwae. Loi ne i ghathaŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye, ne i mboromboro.
